transcript.text: Which tier is the house tier? Answer with the tier name.

args.sql:
SELECT c.tier, COUNT(*) AS order_count
FROM memory.bench.orders o
JOIN memory.bench.customers c ON o.customer_id = c.customer_id
GROUP BY c.tier
ORDER BY order_count DESC

transcript.text:
The "house tier" is defined as the customer tier that placed the most orders. The query results show basic (552 orders) > plus (361) > enterprise (287), so basic is the house tier.

FINAL ANSWER: basic
